items.title: Wilbert Tillman Interview, 1966-01-20
items.q: we was playing with Joe Everett. It was Iber and Tillman's Dixie Land.

ctx.x: So, how long has John had that orchestra?

The Young Tuxedo Orchestra? Well, I'd like to tell you. You might can remember that better than me, because when he was coming to Tyler's, we was playing with Joe Everett. It was Iber and Tillman's Dixie Land. So, after I left, I mean after Joe died, well then John made up the band and named it Young Tuxedo.

items.title: Wilbert Tillman Interview, 1961-08-15
items.q: we broke up his band and then I made up a band and taken him in the band with me and we named it the Tillman and Everett band.

ctx.x: And how long did you play with that band? Joe Everett.

Joe Everett. Joe Everett. Oh we held that band together around about. Well I guess I might as well say up until when Joe died. Cause we broke up his band and then I made up a band and taken him in the band with me and we named it the Tillman and Everett band. But we was playing you know up until his death. He still had that band but we both was working with different bands right on. Cause I mean in this music field if you don't work with different bands you'll never make it. It's not enough night life here for…
Your band was Joe Angry was up at the buzzards club there on the enunciation or someplace?
